text:
Predicates:
BritishShow(x) ::: x is a British sitcom series.
Stars(x, y) ::: x stars y.
Pilots(x, y) ::: x was piloted on y.
WorkingTitle(x, y) ::: x had working title y.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x was the script editor for y.
MemberOfPappys(x) ::: x is a member of Pappy's.
BBC(x, y) ::: x is a BBC channel, y is the number.

Premises:
BritishShow(badults) ∧ Stars(badults, membersOfPappys) ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series starring members of Pappy's.
Pilots(badults, bbcThree) ::: Badults was piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
WorkingTitle(badults, secretDudeSociety) ::: The working title 'The Secret Dude Society' was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.

Conclusion:
¬∃x (MemberOfPappys(x) ∧ ∃y (Stars(y, x) ∧ Pilots(y, bbcTwo) ∨ Pilots(y, bbcThree))) ::: No members of Pappy's have starred in a show piloting on BBC Two or BBC Three.
